movies.title: Inception
movies.summary: Ek chor sapno ke andar ghus kar logon ke vichar churata hai. Is baar use vichar churane nahi, daalne ka kaam milta hai. Kahani parat-dar-parat sapno mein chalti hai.
movies.verdict: Dimaag lagane wali, lekin dekhne mein poori tarah romanchak film.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.summary: Batman, Gotham ka police wala aur ek naya district attorney milkar shehar ke apradh ko todne nikalte hain, tabhi Joker aakar sab kuch ulat deta hai.
movies.verdict: Superhero film se zyada ek gambhir crime thriller. Joker ka kirdaar yaadgaar hai.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.summary: Registan mein ek zalim shasak se bhaagti auraton ko max aur furiosa bachate hain. Poori film ek lambi car chase jaisi hai.
movies.verdict: Shuru se aakhir tak tez raftaar action, kam dialogue aur zabardast stunts.

movies.title: Get Out
movies.summary: Ek naujawan apni girlfriend ke parivar se milne jaata hai aur dheere-dheere samajhta hai ki wahan kuch gadbad hai.
movies.verdict: Darr aur samajik tippani ka behtareen mel. Ant tak utsukta bani rehti hai.

movies.title: The Conjuring
movies.summary: Ek parivar ko apne naye ghar mein ajeeb ghatnayein hoti hain aur wo do paranormal investigators se madad maangte hain.
movies.verdict: Seedhi-saadi bhoot-pret kahani jo mahaul ke dum par daraati hai.

movies.title: Hereditary
movies.summary: Ek parivar apni dadi ke guzarne ke baad ek ke baad ek bhayanak ghatnaon ka saamna karta hai.
movies.verdict: Dheemi lekin bechain kar dene wali. Kamzor dil walon ke liye nahi.

movies.title: Titanic
movies.summary: Ek jahaaz ke pehle safar mein alag-alag tabqe ke do log pyaar kar baithte hain, jabki jahaaz ka anjaam kareeb aa raha hota hai.
movies.verdict: Bade star-scale par bani amar prem kahani.

movies.title: The Notebook
movies.summary: Ek buzurg ek mahila ko ek purani prem kahani padh kar sunata hai jo do jawan logon ke pyaar aur doori ki hai.
movies.verdict: Bhavuk romantic drama, rone ke liye tissue paas rakhein.

movies.title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
movies.summary: Europe ki yatra par do yuva mil kar pyaar kar baithte hain, lekin ladki ka parivar use pehle se kisi aur ke saath tay kar chuka hai.
movies.verdict: Bollywood romance ka sabse bada naam, aaj bhi taaza lagti hai.

movies.title: Jab We Met
movies.summary: Ek udaas business-man train mein ek bolti hui ladki se milta hai aur uski zindagi badalne lagti hai.
movies.verdict: Halki-phulki, hansi aur dil ko chhoone wali romantic comedy.

movies.title: 3 Idiots
movies.summary: Engineering college ke teen doston ki kahani, jo padhai ke dabav aur asli sapno ke beech sawal uthati hai.
movies.verdict: Hansate hansate zaroori baat kehne wali film.

movies.title: Dangal
movies.summary: Ek purva pehalwan apni betiyon ko kushti ke champion banane ke liye kadi mehnat karwata hai.

movies.title: Tumbbad
movies.summary: Ek gaon ke purane khazane ki laalach ek aadmi ko ek khatarnak devta tak le jaati hai.
movies.verdict: Alag mizaaj ki Hindi horror, drishyon aur vatavaran mein bahut dum.

movies.title: War
movies.summary: Ek agent ko apne hi guru ko pakadne ka kaam milta hai, jo ab baaghi ban chuka hai.
movies.verdict: Stylish stunts aur videshi locations wali masala action film.

movies.title: Andhadhun
movies.summary: Ek pianist jo khud ko andha dikhata hai, ek murder ka gawah ban jaata hai.

movies.title: Gangs of Wasseypur
movies.summary: Dhanbad ke koyla maafia ke teen peedhiyon ke dushmani ki lambi kahani.
movies.verdict: Kachchi aur asli crime saga, bahut yaadgaar dialogue.
